name: Maxwell Alejandro Frost

items.text: On Feb. 25, 2025, Frost called President Trump "grifter in chief" at a House Oversight hearing. He withdrew that phrase but said Trump was grifting. Chairman Comer barred him from further participation and said he would have the sergeant-at-arms remove him. On March 4, 2025, Frost walked out of Trump's joint address wearing a "No Kings Live Here" shirt.
items.why: This is political speech and a protest walkout, a petty moment of partisan conflict, with no finding of wrongdoing and no bearing on any of the owner's criteria.

for_review: The owner-sites search (Frost plus alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) turned up nothing about Frost on any of them. I read the Fox News account of the hearing and Frost's own press release on the walkout. I did not read the hearing transcript or video. The dates (Feb. 25, 2025 hearing; March 4, 2025 address) come from the Fox article's publication date and the press release date. Attendance was not weighed, as instructed. I found nothing that meets the against or open bar, and I did not look beyond this item for other conduct.
